biotools.summary: The BIJ Database is a resource for Brassica juncea seed omics data, providing genomic data on seed development across contrasting genotypes. It leverages computational analysis of transcriptome data to identify and characterize long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) and related regulatory networks.
